mcp_tools.name: data_ml_pipeline_engineering
mcp_tools.title: Data ml pipeline engineering
mcp_tools.description: Submits a data/ML pipeline design record (sources and contracts, ingestion, quality gates, lineage and reproducibility, ML hygiene and splits, lifecycle and serving, monitoring and drift) and returns a deterministic DATA_ML_PIPELINE_READY / DATA_ML_PIPELINE_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including computed total-rows, split-total, and latency/cost-vs-declared-budget checks, with per-check evidence. Checks the declared design record; it builds no pipeline and trains no model.

inputSchema.description: The data/ML pipeline design manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

expect.notes: All 46 checks pass: sources 100+50=150 declared 150; splits 80+40+30=150 declared 150; latency 100 within budget 200 (headroom 100); cost 50 within budget 100 (headroom 50); all booleans true except the three must-be-false red lines false. [Tester corrections: designer nested training.reproducible_with_seeds_and_pinned_env under lineage, features.* under splits, and privacy.pii_in_training_data_without_lawful_basis under splits, which would have left 5 checks missing (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, not READY); moved to the documented top-level training/features/privacy objects. Designer also carried computed quantities only in prose; added structured computed_spot_checks.]
